data_facts_with_para.paragraph: As of 2025, the population of Singapore is projected at 5.87 million, compared to 5.83 million in 2024. It ranks 115th in the world by population and 36th in Asia. The population growth rate in 2025 is projected at 0.63 percent, the 126th highest among 237 countries and dependent territories.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: There are 3.03 million males and 2.84 million females in Singapore. The percentage of the male population is 51.65%, compared to 48.35% of the female population. Singapore has 194k more males than females. The sex ratio in Singapore in 2025 will be 106.828 males per 100 females. Singapore is in the 220th position in terms of the female-to-male ratio.
